note: SIMULATION ONLY. Computed deterministically by esl6_valprep.py with esl6_forget.py and reference events (no judge).
learners: 60 (30 outcomes x A1/A2), same learners and dice in both arms; immediate = end of session 2 (2a applies), delayed = after 7 days of F1

designs.full: COUNTED. Scripted tutor d content. s1: rule+pair + 3 own sentences + item B0, feedback each; s2 (a): rule+pair + new items B1, B2 with feedback; s2 (b): recall item B0 (answered in s1) first, then the same.
designs.light: sensitivity only (lower teaching dose, to rule out a ceiling explanation). s1: rule+pair+item B0, feedback. s2 (a): rule+pair, no item. s2 (b): recall item B0 first, then the same.

rule: pass iff delayed mean (b) > (a) and |immediate mean (b) - (a)| <= 0.03
